claim: The unlocked primary cohort contains 942 matches and 1884 team-innings from 2015 through 2024.
Temporal validation covers 71 matches and 142 innings from 2024.
The fixed runs+wickets benchmark had validation ROC-AUC 0.740 (95% interval 0.642–0.822).
Adding pre-match context to powerplay runs and wickets yielded validation ROC-AUC 0.708; the pre-specified interaction model yielded 0.710.

Model-standardized predicted probability changed by +0.082 across the empirical interquartile run contrast at middle wickets, and by -0.126 across the empirical interquartile wicket contrast at middle runs.
Pitch interaction results are blocked: the outcome-blind pitch subset has 178 unlocked matches, but independent reliability and reconciliation are not cleared.
